## Summary
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/noSvelteInspect`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule doesn't have a fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**warning**](/reference/diagnostics#warning).
- This rule belongs to the following domains:
  - [`svelte`](/linter/domains#svelte)
- Sources: 
  - Same as [`svelte/no-inspect`](https://sveltejs.github.io/eslint-plugin-svelte/rules/no-inspect/)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noSvelteInspect": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Disallow the use of the `$inspect` rune.

`$inspect` is a debugging aid: it logs values to the console every time they change.
It only works during development and becomes a no-op in production builds, so calls
to it are usually leftovers from a debugging session that clutter the console and
the code.

The rule reports every use of `$inspect`, including `$inspect(...).with(...)` and
`$inspect.trace()`.

## Examples

### Invalid

```svelte
<script>
let count = $state(0);
$inspect(count);
</script>
```
